dataset.name: CHAMP
dataset.description: CDC Hemophilia A Mutation Project variant registry
dataset.caveat: Rows without a reported inhibitor history are excluded. That exclusion is very unlikely to be random, so the positive rate describes this registry's reporting, not population incidence.

excluded_columns.HGVS cDNA: near-unique identifier (2296 distinct values over 2296 labelled rows)
excluded_columns.Reference Number: LEAKAGE: identifies the source publication, not the variant. Grouped by reference, some studies are 100% inhibitor-positive and others 0%, because inhibitor-focused papers report inhibitor-positive variants. Including it would let the model recover the label from the citation.
excluded_columns.Year Reported: reporting artifact rather than biology, and the column contains an out-of-range 0.0
excluded_columns.Severe (<1 U/dL): 45-90% null; superseded by Reported Clinical Severity
excluded_columns.Moderate (1-5 U/dL): 45-90% null; superseded by Reported Clinical Severity
excluded_columns.Mild (>5 U/dL): 45-90% null; superseded by Reported Clinical Severity
excluded_columns.No FVIII level given: 45-90% null; superseded by Reported Clinical Severity

threshold.criterion: max F1 on the validation split

limitations: CHAMP rows are F8 variants, not patients. Predictions are variant-attributable and are not an individual's probability.
1754 rows without a reported inhibitor history were excluded. That exclusion is very unlikely to be random, so metrics describe the reported subset of this registry.
Reference Number (source publication) was excluded as a leakage feature; some studies are 100% inhibitor-positive by selection.
No external validation cohort. Not clinically validated.
